description: P2 CPU-only AXI4-Lite scenario: the pinned PicoRV32 AXI4-Lite master (picorv32_axi) with one unified AR/R + AW/W/B port served by host RAM. This core exports no RVFI retirement pair and no mem_instr, so retirement and trap are reported unknown; a case passes on its own completion store (sentinel 0xffffffff -> 0) and on the data window matching the reference model, never on bus success alone. The CPU artifact is resolved from the profile on each invocation.
